1.
In  the  peculiar  facts  of  these  cases  where  an
employee has been continuing in service for the last
more than 20 years, we are not inclined to interfere
with the impugned order passed by the High Court.  
2.
The  civil  appeals  are,  accordingly,  dismissed,
however, leaving the question of law open.  
No costs.
